mapper.update:

content = #{request.content}, start_date = #{request.startDate}, end_date = #{request.endDate}, writer_id = #{writerId}, updated_at = NOW()

mapper.select: SELECT quote_id AS quoteId, content, start_date AS startDate, end_date AS endDate, writer_id AS writerId, created_at AS createdAt FROM quotes WHERE state = 'normal' ORDER BY quote_id DESC

SELECT quote_id AS quoteId, content, start_date AS startDate, end_date AS endDate, writer_id AS writerId, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM quotes WHERE state = 'normal' AND CURDATE() BETWEEN start_date AND end_date ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 1
